The main takeaway from our work is that
the scrutiny of government performance in Australia, as in other countries, is not a technical exercise but rather a political and cultural one.
the scrutiny of the Australian public service by the Australian Parliament is a complex and dynamic process that is not easily captured by any single set of rules or procedures.
there is no single best model of parliamentary scrutiny. Each country needs to find the right mix for its own political, administrative and cultural context.
